final: WITH per_currency AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(CASE WHEN rebtotal <> 0 THEN rebtotal END) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(CASE WHEN rebrate <> 0 AND feerate <> 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) AS avg_relative_gap FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal) AS mean_avg_rebtotal FROM per_currency) SELECT AVG(p.avg_rebtotal) AS avg_of_avg_rebtotal, AVG(p.avg_relative_gap) AS avg_of_avg_relative_gap, AVG(p.avg_rebtotal - b.mean_avg_rebtotal) AS avg_excess_over_benchmark FROM per_currency AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_rebtotal > b.mean_avg_rebtotal
